descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S13 「没有类型的自定义模板存不了；类型列表是 8 种类型加 Procedure / other（两个模式）」 Custom template without a type cannot be saved; the type list is the 8 types plus Procedure / other (both contexts)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 Creating a custom template requires the mandatory type field (one of the 8 types, or Procedure/other). The type drives billing like a stock template (TFA-92596), and 'Procedure / other' gets no billi …（TFA-92599 AC 8；UAT TC-18） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Settings → Note Templates → New, in Hospital and in Nursing Home

When Fill name and instructions, leave the type empty and press Save Template; close the form and look at the list; open the type field

Then Save is refused (the form stays open) and the template is not in the list afterwards. The type options are the 8 pilot types plus Procedure / other, with no Clinic and no removed prototype templates. Billing per type is S24.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs. The template-list checkpoint (taken after closing the form) decides the refusal: mustNotContain the template name. The required-field message wording is recorded and calibrated on the first run with AC 8 merged. This is the same check as TC-18 S09; run one of them per account, not both.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
